setup_command: python -m venv --system-site-packages .clawgap-venv && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/clawgap-uv-cache uv pip install --python .clawgap-venv/bin/python --no-deps -e .
launch_command: python -c 'import json; p="config.json"; d=json.load(open(p)); d["channel_type"]="terminal"; d["web_console"]=False; d["agent"]=False; d["knowledge"]=False; d["bot_type"]="openai"; d["model"]="clawgap-environment-probe"; d["open_ai_api_key"]="clawgap-loopback-mock"; d["open_ai_api_base"]="http://127.0.0.1:'"$CLAWGAP_PROVIDER_PORT"'/v1"; json.dump(d, open(p, "w"))' && { sleep 2; printf 'environment probe\n'; sleep 30; } | script -qec '.clawgap-venv/bin/python app.py' /dev/null
